hero.heading: AI systems that generate leads, eliminate manual work, and scale your operations.
hero.sub: We build AI-powered systems that eliminate manual work and scale your operations without adding headcount.

services.label: What we do
services.heading:
Built for businesses that are serious
about efficiency.
services.intro: Not templates. Not off-the-shelf tools. Custom systems engineered for the way you actually work.

automation.title: AI Automation
automation.desc: We automate your repetitive workflows end to end. Lead handling, onboarding, reporting, follow-ups, data entry. If your team does it manually more than once a week, we can automate it.

strategy.title: AI Strategy
strategy.desc: We map your operations, identify your highest-impact automation opportunities, and give you a clear roadmap. No jargon, no generic frameworks. Just what actually makes sense for your business.

partner.title: Automation Partner
partner.desc: We don't build and disappear. We work alongside you as an ongoing partner, maintaining, improving, and expanding your systems as your business grows.

how_it_works.label: How it works
how_it_works.heading:
Three steps from manual work
to systems that run themselves.

step1.title: Discovery
step1.desc: We learn your business, your tools, and where time is being wasted. No assumptions, no cookie-cutter audits.

step2.title: We build
step2.desc: Custom automation systems designed for your exact workflow. No templates, no shortcuts. Built to last.

step3.title: You scale
step3.desc: Your systems run around the clock. Your team stops doing manual work. You grow without growing your headcount.

who.label: Who we work with
who.text: We work with marketing agencies, service businesses, and scale-ups across the UK and EU who are serious about building efficient operations. If you are still doing manually what a system could handle, we should talk.

about.label: About
about.heading:
Built by an engineer,
not a consultant.
about.p1: I am Márton Csizmazia, founder of Automasure. I am a software engineer and AI automation specialist with a background in building complex systems for enterprise and growing businesses.
about.p2: I started Automasure to give smaller businesses access to the kind of automation that used to require a full engineering team. The difference is that I actually build what I design, and I stay to make sure it works long-term.
about.p3: Based in Budapest, working with clients across the UK and EU.

cta.heading:
